summary.text: Jon DiPietro is a Republican candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Hillsborough 39, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A software engineer who earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Lowell, DiPietro previously ran for the Manchester Board of School Committee.

paragraphs.text: DiPietro graduated from the University of Lowell with a bachelor's degree and has worked as a software engineer and a digital marketing consultant.
Ballotpedia lists him as affiliated with the Executive Board of the International Society of Automation and the Board of Directors of Automation.com.
DiPietro's first run for office came in 2017, in the Manchester school board elections.
In a 2017 Ballotpedia survey, he said he hoped to "get the gears moving again in MSD by supporting curriculum excellence, smaller class sizes, and reduce bureaucracy."

In 2019 he advanced from the nonpartisan primary for the Manchester Board of School Committee, Ward 6, but incumbent Dan Bergeron defeated him in the November 5 general election, 55.0 percent to 44.7 percent.
